about: How an ability physically happens in Elden Ring. Each row becomes one Rust struct implementing the delivery.

columns.hits_per_cast: how many hits one cast lands; per-hit damage = attack rating x dmg_mult / sqrt(hits_per_cast)
columns.streams: parallel bullets per shot (beams fire several side by side to look massive)
columns.hook: row id in hooks sheet it depends on

rows.how: a charge, then a stream of bullets toward the target ending in a big blast (scripts.rs)
a volley of small forward bullets
rapid short-range hit bullets in front of the player
dash at the locked-on or nearest enemy in front, then the hit (scripts.rs)
fast reposition with a trailing hit bullet
Raging Strike: vanish and reappear behind the target with a point-blank strike (the old wait-to-be-hit stance looked like nothing happened)
leap or rise into the air, hang, then dive onto the target with a large burst
a line of bullets along the ground toward the target
